parameters.name: EncryptionAlgorithm
parameters.description:
The encryption algorithm. Valid values:

- AES\_128\_CBC

- AES\_128\_GCM

- AES\_128\_CTR

- AES\_128\_ECB

- AES\_256\_CBC

- AES\_256\_GCM

- AES\_256\_CTR

- AES\_256\_ECB

- SM4\_128\_CBC

- SM4\_128\_GCM

- SM4\_128\_CTR

- SM4\_128\_ECB

parameters.name: EncryptionKey
parameters.description: The ID of the customer managed key (CMK) from Key Management Service (KMS). This parameter is required when you set `EncryptionKeyMode` to `kms_key`.

parameters.name: EncryptionKeyMode
parameters.description:
The source of the encryption key for column encryption. Valid values:

- `client_key`: a randomly generated key that is managed on the client.

- `kms_key`: a CMK that is managed in KMS.

> After you configure an instance to use a key from KMS, you cannot change the key source to `client_key`.

parameters.name: EncryptionStatus
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable column encryption. Valid values:

- `1`: Enabled

- `0`: Disabled

parameters.name: IsRotate
parameters.description: Specifies whether to rotate the key.

parameters.name: RoleArn
parameters.description:
The Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the RAM role. For more information, see RAM role overview.
> This parameter applies only when you set `EncryptionKeyMode` to `kms_key`. If you do not specify this parameter, a default internal value is used.

parameters.name: WhiteListMode
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable the allowlist. If you set this parameter to `true`, only columns in the allowlist are encrypted. If you set this parameter to `false`, all columns are encrypted.
